title: Ankhorage Expo Google Fonts Orchestrator Module
summary: Installs and configures Expo Google Fonts through the Ankhorage Orchestrator module boundary.
purpose: Express Google Fonts project changes as deterministic Orchestrator lifecycle actions and explicit host configuration.
responsibilities: Define Google Fonts module configuration and lifecycle behavior.
Provide template files required by configured Expo Google Fonts.
Expose host integration for the installed font configuration.
boundaries: Does not own the Orchestrator lifecycle engine or Expo runtime.
Does not publish Google font packages or choose an application's visual design.
Does not manage arbitrary non-Google font providers.
audience: Expo projects installing Google Fonts through Ankhorage Orchestrator.
Module composition code that requires explicit font host integration.
useCases: Install configured Google Fonts into an Expo project.
Generate the module-owned font template files.
Bind the installed font configuration through the host entrypoint.

architecture.role: Provider module adapting Expo Google Fonts to Orchestrator lifecycle and host boundaries.
invariants: Project mutations are expressed through the published Orchestrator module API.
Font-provider behavior stays within the module adapter.
Host integration remains an explicit public entrypoint.

limitations: Supports Google Fonts packages compatible with the module configuration.
Font availability and loading remain subject to the configured Expo environment.
